prompt: Name a whale, dolphin or porpoise

answers.name: Blue whale
answers.fact: The largest animal known to have ever lived.

answers.name: Killer whale
answers.fact: Actually the largest member of the dolphin family.

answers.name: Humpback whale
answers.fact: Males sing complex songs that change over the years.

answers.name: Bottlenose dolphin
answers.fact: Each one has a 'signature whistle' that works like a name.

answers.name: Sperm whale
answers.fact: Has the largest brain of any animal.

answers.name: Beluga
answers.fact: Nicknamed the 'sea canary' for its chirps and whistles.

answers.name: Narwhal
answers.fact: Its 'tusk' is a tooth that can grow up to 3 metres.

answers.name: Minke whale
answers.fact: One of the smallest baleen whales.

answers.name: Fin whale
answers.fact: The second-largest animal on Earth.

answers.name: Grey whale
answers.fact: Makes one of the longest migrations of any mammal.

answers.name: Right whale
answers.fact: Whalers called it the 'right' whale to hunt.

answers.name: Bowhead whale
answers.fact: Can live for over 200 years.

answers.name: Sei whale
answers.fact: One of the fastest whales, reaching around 50 km/h.

answers.name: Bryde's whale
answers.fact: Pronounced 'broo-dus'.

answers.name: Pilot whale
answers.fact: Actually a large dolphin.

answers.name: False killer whale
answers.fact: Another big dolphin, with an orca-like skull.

answers.name: Common dolphin
answers.fact: Travels in groups of hundreds, even thousands.

answers.name: Spinner dolphin
answers.fact: Can spin up to seven times in a single leap.

answers.name: Risso's dolphin
answers.fact: Older ones are covered in white scars.

answers.name: Dusky dolphin
answers.fact: Famous acrobats off Kaikōura, New Zealand.

answers.name: Hector's dolphin
answers.fact: One of the smallest dolphins, found only in New Zealand.

answers.name: Irrawaddy dolphin
answers.fact: A rounded face with no beak.

answers.name: Amazon river dolphin
answers.fact: Males turn pinker as they age.

answers.name: Vaquita
answers.fact: The world's rarest marine mammal, with only around ten left.

answers.name: Harbour porpoise
answers.fact: Its snorting breath earned it the name 'puffing pig'.

answers.name: Striped dolphin
answers.fact: A dark stripe runs from its eye to its tail.

answers.name: Spotted dolphin
answers.fact: Born plain; the spots come with age.

answers.name: Pygmy killer whale
answers.fact: A small, rarely seen dolphin of tropical seas.

answers.name: Melon-headed whale
answers.fact: Another 'whale' that's really a dolphin.

answers.name: Ganges river dolphin
answers.fact: Nearly blind, it finds its way by echolocation.

answers.name: Baiji
answers.fact: Declared functionally extinct in 2006.

answers.name: Dall's porpoise
answers.fact: Throws up a 'rooster tail' of spray at speed.

answers.name: Finless porpoise
answers.fact: No dorsal fin, just a low ridge.

answers.name: Baird's beaked whale
answers.fact: One of the biggest beaked whales.

answers.name: Northern bottlenose whale
answers.fact: Can dive for over an hour.

answers.name: Pygmy sperm whale
answers.fact: Squirts a cloud of reddish ink to escape predators.

answers.name: Dwarf sperm whale
answers.fact: Barely bigger than some dolphins.

answers.name: Commerson's dolphin
answers.fact: Black and white: nicknamed the 'panda dolphin'.

answers.name: Australian snubfin dolphin
answers.fact: Only described as a separate species in 2005.

answers.name: Atlantic white-sided dolphin
answers.fact: Lives in big, lively groups in the cold North Atlantic.

answers.name: Pacific white-sided dolphin
answers.fact: Famously acrobatic in the cold North Pacific.

answers.name: Hourglass dolphin
answers.fact: Named for the white hourglass pattern on its sides.

answers.name: Rough-toothed dolphin
answers.fact: Its teeth have fine wrinkles.

answers.name: Fraser's dolphin
answers.fact: Known only from a skull until it was seen alive in 1971.

answers.name: Indo-Pacific humpback dolphin
answers.fact: Hong Kong's famous pink-skinned dolphins.

answers.name: Heaviside's dolphin
answers.fact: Lives only off the south-west coast of Africa.

answers.name: Omura's whale
answers.fact: Not described as a species until 2003.

answers.name: Rice's whale
answers.fact: Lives only in the Gulf of Mexico, with under 100 left.

answers.name: Spade-toothed whale
answers.fact: Never seen alive: known from a few bones and two stranded bodies.

answers.name: Burrunan dolphin
answers.fact: Lives in Melbourne's Port Phillip Bay, and was only named in 2011.

answers.name: Tucuxi
answers.fact: A small grey dolphin of the Amazon.

answers.name: Spectacled porpoise
answers.fact: A dark eye patch rimmed in white, like spectacles.

answers.name: Cuvier's beaked whale
answers.fact: The deepest-diving mammal known, reaching nearly 3,000 m.
